patterns.reason: Ant <javadoc> targets that do not already pass -Xdoclint:none will fail the build under JDK 8's stricter default javadoc checker (JEP 172).

rule_description: JEP 172 (DocLint) bundles a Javadoc comment checker into the javadoc tool and enables it by default starting with JDK 8. Malformed HTML or missing tags in Javadoc comments that previously produced at most a warning now fail the javadoc build outright, unless -Xdoclint:none (or a narrower -Xdoclint:<group> selection) is passed.
rule_name: javadoc DocLint enabled by default in JDK 8
verification_hint: Run `ant doc` under the JDK 8 Docker image; verify it no longer fails on malformed Javadoc comments once -Xdoclint:none (or a documented narrower flag) is present on both <javadoc> elements.
